I hope my Editor has rubbed it in about our sorry show in the Brighton relay race somewhere else in this issue Still we enjoyed ourselves and the break-down of the bus coming back gave Bayliss a chance to show off his thumping of the domino box.

It was pleasing to see Bayliss amongst the prizes; quite a long time has passed since he was mentioned. Our Secretary is a good team man, and generally sacrifices his own chances in helping and encouraging others along.
